title: 第5章 立功
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“先把他抓起来！”

壮汉沈哥一声令下，十几个小喽啰一拥而上，把林珝团团围住。

林珝却站在原地连步子都没挪，只是抱起胳膊，把目光越过那些凶神恶煞的脸，落在人墙后面的三小姐身上。

他记得这个女人叫苏悦——是原身记忆里，为数不多还算清晰的名字。

明明和自己拜过堂，喝过交杯酒，是自己名义上的妻子。

但此刻的眼神却冷得像腊月的冰碴子，好像在打量一个仇人似的。

林珝穿过来没几天，还没搞明白这股恨意打哪儿来。

但他清楚一件事，想在这个土匪窝里平安活下去，自己首要的任务，必须尽快搞定这个女人。

于是他换了一副态度，不紧不慢地开口说，“我说娘子，你就用这种方式招呼自家夫君？”

“住口！”

这一声“娘子”，让苏悦眼神微眯，面无表情地一抬手，周围喽啰的刀“唰”地齐刷刷抽出半截，

“你根本不配叫我娘子！”

“不配？”

林珝歪了歪头，对她眨了眨眼，“既然觉得我不配，你干嘛要跟我拜堂？咱们可是当众喝过交杯酒的。”

“你……”苏悦被噎住了。

婚约是真的，拜堂也是真的，这点她确实赖不掉。

只不过，自己当时的打算是先借和这个废物拜堂的事，堵住山寨上下的嘴，等保全了老爹的名声再把人关押起来。

从没想过当真和他做夫妻。

她吸了口气，重新摆出那副冷冰冰的面孔，

“既然当了黑风寨的姑爷，就该安分待着，你故意纵火逃跑，还有理了？”

林珝在心里翻了个白眼。

大姐，刚拜完堂就把人关柴房，换谁不跑？

但他知道这会儿不是讲理的时候，况且自己跟这位刁蛮任性的苏三小姐之间，似乎也没什么道理可讲。

他把双手枕到脑后，语气里带上了几分痞气，“知道娘子舍不得我，我这不是又回来了吗？”

苏悦秀眉一颦，却拿这个口无遮拦的家伙没什么办法，只好压下火气，恢复了先前那副冷漠面孔，

“想走就走，想回就回，你把黑风寨当成了什么地方？”

说罢，她朝沈哥使了个眼色。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

"Catch him first!"

The strong man Shen Ge gave an order, and more than a dozen young men swarmed up and surrounded Lin Sui.

However, Lin Jue stood there without even moving. She just crossed her arms and looked past the fierce faces to the third lady behind the wall of people.

He remembered that this woman's name was Su Yue - one of the few names that was still clear in his original memory.

She has obviously met her and had a glass of wine with her, and she is his wife in name only.

But at this moment, his eyes were as cold as ice in the twelfth lunar month, as if he was sizing up an enemy.

It had only been a few days since Lin Juicuan came here, but she still hadn't figured out where this hatred came from.

But he knew one thing. If he wanted to survive safely in this bandit's den, his first priority was to get rid of this woman as soon as possible.

So he changed his attitude and said slowly, "Madam, is this how you greet your husband?"

"Shut up!"

The sound of "ma'am" made Su Yue narrow her eyes slightly, raise her hand expressionlessly, and pull out half of the knives around her with a "swish" sound.

"You don't deserve to call me sissy!"

"Not worthy?"

Lin Jue tilted her head and winked at her, "Since you think I'm not worthy, why do you want to pay homage to me? We've had a drink together in public."

"You..." Su Yue was choked.

The engagement was real, and so was the wedding, which she really couldn't rely on.

However, my plan at that time was to use the matter of worshiping this good-for-nothing to silence the people in the village, and then imprison him after my father's reputation was preserved.

I never thought about actually becoming a couple with him.

She took a breath and put on her cold face again,

"Since you have become the uncle of Black Wind Village, you should live peacefully. Is it still reasonable for you to deliberately set fire to escape?"

Lin Jue rolled her eyes in her heart.

Sister, you locked people up in the firewood shed just after worshiping. Who else wouldn’t run away?

But he knew that this was not the time to be reasonable, and there seemed to be no reason to reason between himself and the unruly and willful Miss Su San.

He put his hands behind his head and said with a bit of scorn in his tone, "I know my wife can't bear to leave me, so am I back again?"

Su Yue frowned, but there was nothing she could do about this guy who spoke so freely. She had no choice but to suppress her anger and regain her previous indifferent expression.

"You can leave if you want, and come back if you want. What do you think of Black Wind Village?"

After saying that, she winked at Brother Shen.
